credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/lotus.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: REARING: the pink cup of pointed petals leans over the foe on a tall C stalk, the pale pod in its heart; a big cupped leaf held as a shield sheds a bead, a second leaf high behind, lotus-root feet. Intro: the flower is a shut bud; it swells and the petals FLARE open past rest round the glinting pod, then settle. Crystal rule: teal dark, lotus pink light. Sport: Nelumbo nucifera 'Alba Grandiflora' (the great white lotus).
